A sibling workspace package is not linked by its peer range alone - pnpm went to the registry. The peer states what a consumer supplies; a devDependency of workspace:* links the sibling in development.

phase3.roadmapInstruction: Small. Resist building a state framework.
whyNothingWasBuilt: Angular already ships the adapters: toSignal/toObservable in @angular/core/rxjs-interop ARE the boundary conversions ADR-003 describes. Wrapping them adds a TEKAD name, version and migration cost on top of an API Angular maintains.
No caller exists. A "value | Signal | Observable" normaliser is plausible but the first real component will define its shape better than speculation (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
Signals already ARE the state framework. The useful work is enforcement, which is a review problem rather than a library problem.
phase3.whatWasBuilt: ADR-002/ADR-003 review blockers as no-restricted-syntax rules scoped to packages/**
rules: BehaviorSubject/ReplaySubject banned (state by construction); a plain Subject modelling an event stream is ALLOWED - exactly the line ADR-003 draws
.set()/.update() inside effect() banned; effect() touching the DOM or moving focus is ALLOWED
subscribe-then-set by hand banned; toSignal at the boundary is ALLOWED
NgModule decorator banned in packages (ADR-004, moved here from the repo-wide block - it is a rule about what TEKAD ships)
phase3.selfTest: tools/verify-reactive-rules.test.mjs - 9 cases: 5 violations that must be reported, 4 allowed forms that must not be. The allowed cases carry equal weight: a rule that fires on correct code gets disabled.

a providedIn:'root' rule - none exist yet; the tree-shaking probe grows a scenario when the first appears

gamutFitting.firstBuildFailed: 19 tones fell outside the sRGB gamut
gamutFitting.rejectedFix: a hand-tuned chroma table per hue - at L=0.30 yellow runs out at ~0.063 chroma while blue reaches ~0.174, so any fixed table is wrong for the next hue added
gamutFitting.chosenFix: reduce chroma until the colour fits, holding lightness and hue. Silent channel clamping would make the browser render a colour the contrast gate never examined.

built.package: @tekad/core/a11y/live-announcer - its own secondary entry point so an app that never announces never pays for it
correctnessDecisions: lazy browser-only region creation - SSR has no DOM, and creating the region during hydration is a mismatch
clear-before-set - a live region fires on a CHANGE, so announcing the same string twice is otherwise silently dropped
one region per politeness - politeness is read when the region is first encountered, so flipping the attribute is unreliable
visually hidden by CLIPPING - display:none / visibility:hidden / hidden / aria-hidden each remove the element from the accessibility tree, the most common way a live region announces nothing

notBuilt.focusTrap: NARROWER than ADR-010 implies. showModal() already grants inert, aria-modal, Escape and focus restore at 96.1%, and non-modal popovers should not trap focus at all - so a bespoke trap is needed ONLY on the position:fixed fallback path, and that should be confirmed against a real fallback before building for it.
